description: This file defines the MessageCommandResponse interface, which serves as a base interface for various response messages related to messages in the system. It includes methods for retrieving message details, resource paths, and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static JSON field definitions for MessageCommandResponse's JSON representation, including 'thingId', 'message', 'headers', and deprecated 'payload' fields.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the Message object to be delivered.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Provides the type of the message, used for routing over AMQP.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Default method returning the ThingId associated with this message response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string associated with MessageCommand.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path for the resource based on message direction and subject.
